images.title: Director Orion's Briefing
images.purpose: Key scene image for the mission's Discovery beat, where Director Orion explains the probationary expedition to Outpost Echo.
images.description: Director Orion, standing in a calm, softly lit briefing room at Explorer Academy Headquarters, addressing the learner. A holographic or paper map of Outpost Echo is visible between them. The mood is welcoming but serious — the beginning of a genuine trial, not a casual invitation.
images.style: Warm, painterly illustration consistent with the campaign's exploration theme; avoid photorealism.

images.title: Arrival at Outpost Echo
images.purpose: Key establishing scene for the mission's Hook beat — the learner's first sight of the deserted station.
images.description: The exterior of Outpost Echo: a research station showing clear signs of hasty departure rather than ruin — equipment left out, a door ajar, no visible damage. Quiet and still rather than frightening; the mood is mystery, not danger.
images.style: Warm, painterly illustration consistent with the campaign's exploration theme; avoid photorealism.

images.title: Example Sketch Map of Outpost Echo
images.purpose: Reference exemplar for the Core 'Produce a Simple Sketch Map' and Extension 'Improve the Station Map' activities, showing what a clearly labelled sketch map with a symbol key looks like.
images.description: A simple hand-drawn-style map diagram of Outpost Echo's main areas as known at this point in the story (entrance, main corridor, laboratory, living quarters), with a small key in one corner showing 2-3 basic symbols. Deliberately plain and legible rather than decorative, so it reads as something a learner could realistically produce themselves.
images.style: Simple line-art map diagram, not a painted scene.

images.title: The Assembled Explorer Toolkit
images.purpose: Key scene image for the mission's Breakthrough beat, where the learner assembles a complete investigation kit.
images.description: A flat-lay arrangement of an Explorer's toolkit on a wooden table or station desk: an Explorer Journal, a ruler, a tape measure, a pencil, and a few small sample containers. No characters needed — the kit itself is the subject.
images.style: Warm, painterly illustration consistent with the campaign's exploration theme; avoid photorealism.

images.title: A Name in the Static
images.purpose: Key scene image for the mission's Breakthrough beat, where the learner first discovers Dr. Elara Quinn's name among the recovered logs.
images.description: The damaged communications terminal at Outpost Echo, its screen flickering with corrupted static and fragments of text, with the partially legible name 'E. QUINN' visible among the noise. Dr. Quinn herself is not shown — she is known only through records at this point in the story, so no character or portrait should appear.
images.style: Warm, painterly illustration consistent with the campaign's exploration theme; avoid photorealism.

images.title: Strange Footprints
images.purpose: Key scene image for the mission's Hook beat, where the learner discovers a series of unusual footprints outside the station.
images.description: A trail of unusual footprints in soft ground just outside Outpost Echo, leading away toward the treeline or rocks. The tracks should read as genuinely ambiguous — not obviously human, not obviously any specific named animal — so the image doesn't give away the mission's conclusion.
images.style: Warm, painterly illustration consistent with the campaign's exploration theme; avoid photorealism.

images.title: Restarting the Weather Station
images.purpose: Key scene image for the mission's Hook beat, where the learner restarts the station's weather observations.
images.description: The Weather Station at Outpost Echo: a small, intermittently functioning instrument shelter with dials and a wind vane, the learner adjusting or reading one of its instruments under an open sky. The mood is quiet, methodical curiosity rather than drama.
images.style: Warm, painterly illustration consistent with the campaign's exploration theme; avoid photorealism.

images.title: The Broken Bridge
images.purpose: Key scene image for the mission's Hook beat, where the learner discovers the collapsed access bridge blocking the Storage Facility.
images.description: A small access bridge at Outpost Echo, partially collapsed in the middle, spanning a narrow gap or ravine toward the Storage Facility entrance. Weathered and long-neglected rather than freshly wrecked, consistent with an outpost abandoned years ago.
images.style: Warm, painterly illustration consistent with the campaign's exploration theme; avoid photorealism.

images.title: The Communications Array Restored
images.purpose: Key scene image for the mission's Hook beat, where Atlas restores part of the outpost's communications array.
images.description: The Communications Array/Terminal room at Outpost Echo, a console lighting up with a waveform display showing a corrupted, static-broken audio signal. No character or portrait of Dr. Elara Quinn should appear — the transmission is heard, not seen, and she remains known only through records at this point in the story.
images.style: Warm, painterly illustration consistent with the campaign's exploration theme; avoid photorealism.

images.title: The Laboratory's Uncatalogued Samples
images.purpose: Key scene image for the mission's Hook beat, where the learner finds carefully catalogued but incompletely labelled samples.
images.description: A shelf or workbench inside Outpost Echo's Laboratory, holding a row of small labelled and unlabelled sample containers of varying colours and textures, catalogue cards scattered nearby. Orderly rather than chaotic — this was careful work left unfinished, not a mess.
images.style: Warm, painterly illustration consistent with the campaign's exploration theme; avoid photorealism.

images.title: The Failing Water System
images.purpose: Key scene image for the mission's Hook beat, where the station's water recycling system is discovered to have partially failed.
images.description: A utility area of Outpost Echo showing exposed pipework, a storage tank and a control panel with one indicator light blinking amber, a faint drip of water visible at a joint. Understated malfunction, not a dramatic leak or flood.
images.style: Warm, painterly illustration consistent with the campaign's exploration theme; avoid photorealism.

images.title: Station Water System Diagram
images.purpose: Reference diagram for the Core 'Trace Water Flow' and 'Interpret Diagrams' activities, which explicitly require following the station's pipework diagram — the mission cannot be completed without one existing.
images.description: A simple schematic diagram of the station's water recycling loop: Intake, Filter, Storage Tank, Pump, Distribution Pipes, Recycling Unit, looping back to Filter. Plain labelled boxes and arrows, no decoration — legible enough for a learner to mark a suspected fault location directly on it.
images.style: Simple line-art schematic diagram, not a painted scene.

images.title: The Station's Power Panel
images.purpose: Key scene image for the mission's Breakthrough beat, where major systems return online.
images.description: A control panel inside Outpost Echo with several labelled switches and indicator lights, most now glowing steadily after being restored, one or two still dark awaiting later missions. No characters needed — the panel itself tells the story.
images.style: Warm, painterly illustration consistent with the campaign's exploration theme; avoid photorealism.

images.title: The Observatory's Star Chart
images.purpose: Reference diagram for the Core 'Measure Angles' activity, giving the learner recorded star positions to measure between — matching the Campaign 01 example in ASSET_COMPILER.md, which notes Mission 12 needs a star-chart spec.
images.description: A simple star chart as it would appear in the station's damaged Observatory: a scattering of labelled star positions on a plain grid, plotted accurately enough that angles between them can be measured with a protractor and ruler.
images.style: Simple line-art chart diagram, not a painted scene.

images.title: The Connections Board
images.purpose: Key scene image for the mission's Breakthrough beat, where the hidden pattern connects evidence from several earlier missions at once.
images.description: A corkboard or wall inside Outpost Echo with small labelled cards or photos — a weather chart, a water pipe diagram, a sample jar, a bridge sketch — connected by lengths of string converging on a single central point. Represents the moment scattered investigations turn out to be linked, without needing to depict any specific new plot detail.
images.style: Warm, painterly illustration consistent with the campaign's exploration theme; avoid photorealism.

images.title: Dr. Quinn's Final Notebook Pages
images.purpose: Key scene image for the mission's Investigation beat, where the learner combines surviving notebook pages with other evidence.
images.description: A handful of worn, water-stained notebook pages spread out on a table at Outpost Echo, alongside a magnifying glass, a map, and a few earlier journal entries used for cross-referencing. Dr. Elara Quinn herself is not shown — she remains known only through her records at this point in the story.
images.style: Warm, painterly illustration consistent with the campaign's exploration theme; avoid photorealism.

images.title: The Signal Tower
images.purpose: Key scene image for the mission's Hook/Investigation beats, where the learner inspects the tower's systems up close.
images.description: The Signal Tower at Outpost Echo: a tall, weathered communications mast with visible cabling and an access panel open, the learner (or their equipment) inspecting a section for faults. Overcast sky, sense of a structure long dormant rather than freshly damaged.
images.style: Warm, painterly illustration consistent with the campaign's exploration theme; avoid photorealism.

images.title: The Underground Survey Area
images.purpose: Key scene image for the mission's Hook beat, where restoring power reveals the previously inaccessible underground geological survey area.
images.description: A lantern- or headlamp-lit underground chamber beneath Outpost Echo, showing exposed rock layers along one wall, a small table with catalogued rock samples, and rolled-up survey maps. A sense of careful, ongoing scientific work rather than a natural cave.
images.style: Warm, painterly illustration consistent with the campaign's exploration theme; avoid photorealism.

images.title: Example Geological Field Sketch
images.purpose: Reference exemplar for the Extension 'Produce a Geological Field Sketch' activity, matching the Campaign 01 example in ASSET_COMPILER.md, which notes Mission 16 needs a sketch-map-style spec since its Core/Extension activities produce one.
images.description: A simple hand-drawn-style geological cross-section sketch showing labelled rock layers and one or two surface features, plain and legible rather than decorative, so it reads as something a learner could realistically produce themselves.
images.style: Simple line-art diagram, not a painted scene.

images.title: An Independent Investigation
images.purpose: Key scene image representing the mission's open-ended nature, where the learner defines and runs their own investigation with no fixed topic.
images.description: A station workbench with a deliberately generic mix of everyday investigation materials laid out (a notebook, a ruler, some containers, a torch) — no specific topic implied, since Mission 17's whole point is that the learner chooses their own. The learner's hands are shown arranging materials, not a specific experiment mid-progress.
images.style: Warm, painterly illustration consistent with the campaign's exploration theme; avoid photorealism.

images.title: Example Investigation Board
images.purpose: Reference exemplar for the Extension 'Produce an Investigation Board' activity, whose output is explicitly a visual investigation board — matching the same diagram-output pattern already established for Missions 2 and 16.
images.description: A simple reference version of an investigation board: a handful of labelled cards representing evidence types (a log fragment, a weather chart, a sample jar) connected by string to a central conclusion card. Deliberately generic rather than using specific Campaign 01 plot details, so it reads as a template the learner fills in with their own evidence.
images.style: Simple line-art diagram, not a painted scene.

images.title: The Unlocked Archive
images.purpose: Key scene image for the mission's Hook beat, where the learner unlocks the expedition's protected archive.
images.description: A secure records room or vault at Outpost Echo, its door now open, shelves of carefully preserved files and a single glowing terminal displaying the newly unlocked archive. Dr. Elara Quinn is not shown — no physical description of her exists in the World Bible, and she remains known only through her records throughout the campaign.
images.style: Warm, painterly illustration consistent with the campaign's exploration theme; avoid photorealism.

images.title: Presenting to Explorer Academy
images.purpose: Key scene image for the mission's Breakthrough beat, where the learner presents their conclusions.
images.description: The learner presenting findings — journal open, evidence laid out — to Director Orion and Atlas in a Mission Control-style room, both listening attentively rather than judging. The topic of the investigation itself is left generic, since Mission 20 is deliberately open-ended.
images.style: Warm, painterly illustration consistent with the campaign's exploration theme; avoid photorealism.

images.title: Graduation Day
images.purpose: Key scene image for the mission's Breakthrough beat, where the learner officially graduates and receives their Explorer Certificate — deliberately bookending IMAGE-0001 (Director Orion's Briefing, Mission 1), per Director Orion's World Bible entry: 'Welcomes the learner at the start of the campaign (Mission 1) and again at Graduation (Mission 21).'
images.description: Director Orion presenting the Explorer Certificate to the learner in the same briefing room at Explorer Academy Headquarters as Mission 1's scene, now warmly lit and celebratory rather than serious. Atlas is present in the background. Composition deliberately echoes IMAGE-0001 to visually close the loop.
images.style: Warm, painterly illustration consistent with the campaign's exploration theme; avoid photorealism.
